cast.name: Sol Karrow
cast.role: Junior keeper at Skarn Fell, nineteen. The player character.
cast.want: To belong somewhere that will not be taken away.
cast.flaw: Cannot let anything go. Over-nurses, hoards, and mistakes keeping a thing alive for doing right by it.
cast.voice: Plain and dry, easier with animals than people. 'He's not sulking. He's a drake. That's his face.'
cast.battle: Crook and salves. Her command is Tend: small heals, and coaxing a free minor effect out of whichever beast is beside her.
cast.secret: Her father was a soldier who died waiting for a summon that had been spent on a parade.

cast.name: Bede Orrin
cast.role: Head keeper, sixty-eight. Was once a summoner's squire.
cast.want: For every beast on the Fell to die on the hill in its own time.
cast.flaw: Has decided on the beasts' behalf what they want, and has never checked.
cast.voice: Gruff, agricultural, allergic to feelings. 'She's had a good morning. Don't make a hymn of it.'
cast.battle: Old campaigner. Knows every beast's tells, so he can make a call land harder; never makes one himself.
cast.secret: At the Karst he called Thunder once more than his master ordered. It won the battle and cost the drake his eye and his wing.

cast.name: Old Thunder
cast.role: Storm drake, half blind, arthritic. The most famous summon alive. Three calls left.
cast.want: Nobody knows. He watches the south sky and lifts his head at drums, and also at the dinner gong.
cast.flaw: He comes when called. He always has.
cast.voice: Does not speak. Sneezes static, leans on things, and makes one low sound that Sol says is contentment and Bede says is his chest.
cast.battle: Skybreak ends any encounter outright. For free: his static sometimes stuns whatever is standing too close.
cast.secret: Nothing he does settles whether he wants to fight. The game never tells you.

cast.name: Captain Rook Dessen
cast.role: Remount officer, thirty. Arrives with a list of six names and the authority to take them.
cast.want: To bring enough power down the mountain to keep Carrow, where her family is, from falling.
cast.flaw: Counts in calls, because counting in creatures is how she lost her nerve once.
cast.voice: Brisk, exact, formally polite to the beasts. 'Good morning, sir. I'm told you bite. I'd take it as a kindness if you didn't.'
cast.battle: Sabre and orders. Her command, Direct, gives another party member an immediate turn.
cast.secret: Her regiment's summon, Garnet, was used to nothing in a single afternoon. She was the one relaying the calls.

cast.name: Brine
cast.role: Tidal horse, once the size of a harbour wave, now small enough to sleep in a trough. Five calls left.
cast.want: To be wherever Sol is, preferably wet.
cast.flaw: Follows her into places he should not go.
cast.battle: Spring Tide washes the whole enemy line back and off its feet. For free: douses fires and fills the party's flasks.
cast.secret: He is the only beast on the list who was not asked for. Sol brought him because she could not leave him.

cast.name: Lady Ash
cast.role: A phoenix that no longer rekindles. One call left, and everyone knows what it is.
cast.want: Warmth. She sleeps on the lodge stove.
cast.flaw: None. She is a very old bird.
cast.voice: A dry click of the beak. Sheds one feather when displeased; there are not many.
cast.battle: Last Ember restores the entire party from anything, and is her death. For free: nobody near her can be frozen or frightened.
cast.secret: She has started building a nest out of the lodge's kindling, which the books say a phoenix does only once.

cast.name: Marshal Tobiah Glass
cast.role: The last of the great summoners, eighty. Thunder was bound to him. Lives in honoured retirement in Carrow.
cast.want: To see his drake again and be recognised.
cast.flaw: Remembers the wars as the best years of two lives, his and Thunder's.
cast.voice: Loud, charming, repeats himself. 'We won the Karst, you know. Did I say? We won it.'
cast.battle: None now. His seal is what makes a recall order lawful.
cast.secret: He signed the recall without understanding what the paper was.

places.name: Skarn Fell and the Keepers' Lodge
places.look: Tussock grass, drystone pens built for creatures three times the size of the ones now in them, a lodge with a stove and a ledger nailed to the wall.
places.play: Morning rounds: feed, walk and doctor each beast. Care raises what a beast will do for free; it never raises the number in the ledger.
places.change: Fewer pens in use each time you come back. At the end you do rounds again, and it takes half as long.

places.name: The Burial Hill
places.look: A round green hill above the lodge covered in cairns, each with a brass tag and something left on top: a bit, a bell, a child's drawing.
places.play: Build a cairn for each beast that dies and choose the keepsake; a keepsake is the only permanent equipment in the game.
places.change: It grows. The player chooses where on the hill each one goes, and who is next to whom.

places.name: The Drovers' Stair
places.look: Four days of switchback down the mountain: scree, a rope bridge, a river in spate, weather that changes at each turn.
places.play: An escort dungeon at the pace of the slowest beast. Wolves, rockfall and the first choice between a hard fight and a call.
places.change: Going back up it at the end, lighter, is the last playable stretch.

places.name: Carrow
places.look: A river city behind an old wall, bunting over sandbags, toy drakes in the shop windows, bakers on the parapet with pikes.
places.play: Stable legends in a tannery yard, deal with a city that adores them, and hold the wall at night.
places.change: The bunting comes down in stages. By the last arc the toy drakes are gone from the windows, one way or the other.

places.name: Sedge Flats
places.look: Miles of reed and standing water, causeways of planks, siege engines sunk to their axles, smoke.
places.play: A battlefield crossed in stages with no rest point. The game's hardest fights, and its most reasonable arguments for calling.
places.change: Lady Ash's last call happens here or it does not, and the Flats are remembered by her name if it does.

places.name: The Remount Lines
places.look: The army's stockade for bound beasts: numbered stalls, binding posts, handlers who are not unkind and do not know anyone's name.
places.play: A night infiltration to get your own beasts back out, in which the beasts' free habits are the stealth tools.
places.change: Empty at the end, by your doing or the war's.

places.name: The Hot Spring
places.look: A steaming pool in the rocks behind the lodge, worn smooth on one side by a hundred years of large animals getting in.
places.play: The camp scenes. Whoever is in the water talks; whoever is missing is noticed.
places.change: The same shot at the start and the end, with a different count of heads above the steam.
